text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- For the first time since mid-1996 Portuguese reduce expenditure in consumer goods which could be result of rising expenditure on housing, according to a National Statistics Institute report.
- More than 500,000 people are either out of work or are under-employed, equal to more than 10 percent of the active population, according to National Statistics Institute (INE) figures.
- Grundig workers block traffic on the road Porto-Braga, in northern Portugal in second day of strike against layoffs. Employment ministry negotiating with Grundig.
- Government wants to regulate the widespread illegal offer of accomodation to tourists by imposing taxes on this activity.
- Today the cabinet approves measures to boost competitiveness of small and medium companies totalling 33 billion escudos, including 25 billion from European Union.
